sentences.text: Vastanavis belongs to the Neognathae group of birds, a major lineage of modern avians.
This bird possessed at least semi-zygodactyl feet, a foot structure where toes face both forward and backward, suggesting it was likely an arboreal species that lived in trees.
The genus Vastanavis was first described by Mayr and colleagues in 2007.
The specific species Vastanavis cambayensis was later described by Mayr and colleagues in 2010.
Fossils of Vastanavis date to the Early Eocene epoch, living between 56 and 48.07 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
The two known species, V. eocaena and V. cambayensis, are found in the Cambay Formation.
